news.text: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

news.text: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

news.text: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.

news.text: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.
